meta.title: Recaf MCP
meta.description: Gives the agent the recaf-mcp tool set (classes, methods, search, cross-references, renames, export, bytecode editing) over stdio. DSH starts the MCP server, and the server starts a headless Recaf when no window is running, so no X server and no manual startup are needed. Tools appear as mcp__recaf__<tool>; the first call takes a few seconds while Recaf boots, and the Recaf process stays up for later sessions.
